critical_concerns.description: Required artifact path qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_005 is absent, and the requested alpha_scores.parquet/covariance.parquet exist only in mailbox form. The mailbox alpha_scores schema is sig_ym x Ticker x score_stage, not strict Date x Ticker x score_*, and covariance is only 2x2 sleeve-level rather than full name-level post-shrink Sigma. Governor should not finalize an artifact-complete record without an explicit exception matrix.

Hard constraints are failed, not merely inherited context: weights.csv has 40 names on 230/267 dates and turnover_summary shows Blend annualized one-way TO=6.313 > 6.0. AX-007 multi-sleeve status does not silently amend the base max_names=20 and turnover hard caps; this must remain an explicit rejection ground and future pivot blocker unless Governor/Q-Lead grants an amendment.

AX-008 is still fragile. Architect PASS reproduces numbers, not process validity; source Harvey artifact still reports stale 5/5 PASS and log-penalty DSR, while the narrative says 3 genuine specs and linear DSR. Governor's draft correctly downgrades admission eligibility, but L-330 recording must state process triangulation is insufficient rather than treating directional corroboration as clean verification.

The Path A retire scope remains the weakest governance claim. The evidence supports rejecting this monthly-feature/simple-scorer/proxy implementation; it does not prove all DPL-RC Path A variants are exhausted, especially with S3/S4 implemented as ridge-style proxies and sparse G1 positives. L-330 wording must stay implementation-scoped under AX-000.

Lockbox handling is thin for a governance lesson record: Forge measured through 2026-04 before Judge, and charts contain a marker, but no concrete lockbox access log or Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined decomposition artifact was found. This is tolerable only for no-admission hard-abort, not for admission-grade validation language.

Final must choose either strict no-mutation or explicit audit-log append, with rationale.
